circadian.ORIENTATION: This protocol adjusts day and night signals. A single stable action per day is enough.
circadian.NORMALIZATION_WORSE: If it felt worse today, it may be a temporary response to the change. Observe for two days before concluding.
circadian.SIMPLIFICATION: Reduced load active. Keep only the simplest step today. Stability matters more than volume.
circadian.RE_ENGAGEMENT_48H: A pause was detected. If you return today, use the minimal version: a brief action without optimizing anything else.
circadian.RE_ENGAGEMENT_96H: An extended pause was detected. Restart with a single lever for 48 hours and then resume.
circadian.CLOSURE: Protocol closure. Keep one main lever and define a minimal version for days with little margin.
circadian.TRANSITION: Today prioritize a simple signal. The goal is to reduce friction and maintain consistency.

minimal.ON_L1: Minimal mode active: one action and one check.
minimal.ON_L2: Minimal mode active: one action. No check today.

Orientation.default: The system records signals when available.
Orientation.continue: Consistent logging observed. Continue with planned load.

Normalization.activation: Higher activation observed. This can occur during change. Keep minimum viable load if needed.
Normalization.digestive_variability: Digestive variability observed. Small changes can have latency. Keep minimum viable load if needed.
Normalization.energy_crash: The crash is a physiological signal, not lack of discipline.
Normalization.low_morning_energy: Morning energy adjusts after stabilizing the start of the day.
Normalization.reactive_hunger: Reactive hunger detected. Metabolic signal recalibrating.
Normalization.postmeal_insulin: Postprandial sleepiness associated with insulin response.

Simplification.active: Reduced load active. Only essentials are shown.
Simplification.energy_reduce: Reducing load. Prioritize only the first meal.

Reengagement.48h: Inactivity detected. Minimal load applied to restart.
Reengagement.96h: Extended inactivity. Minimum viable load maintained.
Reengagement.energy_inactive: No recent records. Energy is observed when it appears.
Reengagement.resume_anchor: Resume temporal anchor. One meal at fixed time.

Closure.summary: Closure: choose one minimal practice to continue.
Closure.metabolic_stable: Energy rhythm stabilized. No intervention required.
